title: Fantastic trip through Barcelona
text:
Fantastic tour through the streets of Barcelona
Our guide Nuno was fantastic in the way he helped us adapt to the Segway (we had never ridden one before), after we were comfortable with the machine we walked through several streets in Barcelona with a description of the places where we stopped - High marks for the park with the birds.
Very good,
I recommend
author: JoaquimRSantos

title: Fun Segway Tour of Barcelona
text: The guided night Segway tour of Barcelona was amazing! Riding a Segway through the heart of Barcelona was a fun, efficient way to see the main attractions up close! Our tour guide was super nice and knowledgeable. I highly recommend it!
author: Faye_F

title: Nice experience
text: It was a beautiful experience along with Theresa who told us all nice stories about Barcelona and took a nice preview of the city. I reccomend this segway trip. 1h passed too fast for me. Greetings from Romania!
author: elena24mazilu
